intent.raw: Invoke design first, then plan, for an interactive DomainSpec v2 roadmap section in ide-extension that a new person such as Victor can understand and improve.
intent.objective: Design and plan a governed, proposal-first Roadmap Lab that reuses the trusted-local Canvas, teaches one roadmap node at a time, persists revision-bound proposals, and routes accepted changes to the correct authority without browser-side source mutation.
intent.operator_sentence: Design the smallest understandable Roadmap Lab, validate it as a coherent unit, then plan its governed delivery without implementing it.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The operator requested Invoke authoring, not subagent dispatch. The design and plan are produced locally; future execution owners are recommendations inside SWU contracts and require a separately selected runtime unit.
receipt_requirements: A future selected SWU must return its status, files, validation, blockers, and handoff note.

steps.name: Build bounded design context
stop_conditions: Block if the proposal-first authority boundary or trusted-local Canvas contract cannot be supported by live evidence.

steps.name: Author six-view design
stop_conditions: Block if the browser becomes DomainSpec authority, if the design requires direct roadmap mutation, or if a general source browser is made a prerequisite for the first proof.

steps.name: Validate the design unit
stop_conditions: Do not enter plan mode if the design unit is incoherent, unrecomposable, or acceptance-critical gaps lack owners.

steps.name: Derive layered execution plan
stop_conditions: Block if any non-exempt SWU lacks source anchors, dependencies, write scope, done criteria, acceptance evidence, validation, or an execution owner.
Block if wave order hides the dirty-worktree ownership gate or bypasses the Victor trial.

steps.name: Validate plan units and recomposition
stop_conditions: Block mutation-capable handoff if Distill returns flag or block.

steps.name: Publish planning handoff
stop_conditions: Do not select or execute an SWU during Invoke.

gates.condition: The design contains six consistent views, explicit UX states, decisions, glossary checks, and a coherent smallest unit.
The design unit passes before planning and the plan units pass before handoff.
The Canvas stays a trusted-local presentation and event surface and never becomes DomainSpec, Craft, or Whisper authority.
A future Task Session selects exactly one ready SWU before mutation; the Victor trial requires a real participant and cannot be simulated.
A submitted proposal is only evidence for review; acceptance, source mutation, and promotion remain with their owning lifecycle.

boundaries.contract: The Canvas receives a generated HTML projection and fingerprint; it does not receive authority to edit the roadmap source.

boundaries.to_owner: active local session and proposal review
boundaries.contract: Named JSON events are append-only, bounded, revision-bound proposals or source requests; they are not accepted mutations.
Invoke returns a navigable work-pack. Task Session may later receive exactly one selected SWU and must return a structured receipt.

authority.execution: task-session for one separately selected SWU
authority.validation: schema, Node, Playwright, repository checks, Distill, and real Victor trial
authority.evidence: test output, Canvas events, proposal records, browser artifacts, and human trial report
authority.memory: planning and trial artifacts only; roadmap authority remains outside the Canvas

state_namespaces.write_policy: never written by the browser or Invoke
generated or reviewed presentation wording only
complete HTML revision publication and append-only named interactions

promotion_splits.target: accepted DomainSpec, Craft, Whisper, research, or graph change
promotion_splits.rule: The event must be reviewed and translated by the owning lifecycle; submission alone never proves acceptance or application.

promotion_guardrails: No runtime implementation occurs during Invoke design or plan.
No browser-side direct write to DomainSpec roadmap, Craft ledger, Whisper text, graph claims, or research artifacts.
No proposal is described as accepted or applied without owner-held evidence.
No source resolver, authentication layer, remote collaboration, or multi-user identity is pulled into L0.
No future Task Session starts without one selected ready SWU and dirty-worktree ownership review.
